Job Description

As a Product Manager on the Enterprise AI/ML team, you will be responsible for defining the long-term vision, contributing to the roadmap, and prioritizing executing our Enterprise AI/ML data products. This is an exciting opportunity to help us design and develop data products that let our business stakeholders use and make sense of their data. End-users of these products will be all Procore business users - subject matter experts, decision-makers, and analysts alike - so you will be working with stakeholders from across the enterprise to align everyone on the vision, define requirements, and set priorities. You will partner with other product managers to support the complete vertical pipeline from raw data to UI presentation on various platforms. We are looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team in building a platform to make interacting with key business data fast, simple, and painless for Procorians.

The ideal candidate is deeply passionate about building and enabling business value through data and platform experiences and is adept at applying product management best practices to developing data products. You will bring your expertise in AI/ML, data, and platforms and guide in data strategy and building road mapping with a commitment to creating empowering user experiences. You have honed your communication skills with designers, stakeholders, and engineers.

This position will report to our Director, AI/ML Data Products, with the opportunity to be located in Austin, TX or work remotely from Austin, TX. We’re looking for someone to join our team immediately.

What you'll do:
• Lead the definition, design, and delivery of data products within the Enterprise AI/ML and prioritize features and functionality to obtain maximum performance focused on end-user benefits and understand the needs of various business functions and connect them to new and existing initiatives to maximize the realization of value
• Understand and grow the goals for data capabilities on the platform that need long-term investment and calibrate with the short-term goals of the business
• Contribute towards the vision and create buy-in for our data products vision across the enterprise - aligning a diverse group of stakeholders around the vision for Enterprise AI/ML.
• Develop and maintain the Enterprise AI/ML roadmap; scope and prioritize activities based on business and user impact, which defines product enhancements for short-term and long-term releases
• Gain a deep understanding of end-user needs and experience, identify and fill product gaps, and generate new ideas that grow adoption and improve user experience
• Work closely with our agile, technical data team (engineers, developers, analysts, data scientists) to deliver product features with quick time-to-deployment and optimal resources
• Drive product launches, including working with the program team, the data and engineering teams, executives, and end-user team members

What we're looking for:
• 3+ years experience in the product life cycle and management, preferably with experience building AI/ML, data, and analytics products through a platform-oriented approach
• Experience working with data teams (data engineers, data scientists, software developers, data analysts, etc.), product designers, business stakeholders and end-users
• Proficiency with software development methodologies such as Agile and experience working with Scrum teams and working with Agile software development tools such as Jira
• Skilled at working effectively with cross-functional teams with diverse skill sets with stakeholders across all levels of the organization
• Proficiency with AI/ML concepts, foundational data, modern data warehousing tools, and platform stacks that supports and scales petabytes of data daily across hundreds of users that have varying levels of exposure to technology
• Experience or exposure to predictive analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence and their applications for creating insights and experiences that enrich business processes
• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written. Must be able to communicate effectively and confidently with users, team members, and management

Procore Technologies is building the software that builds the world. We provide cloud-based construction management software that helps clients more efficiently build skyscrapers, hospitals, retail centers, airports, housing complexes, and more. CEO - AI Insurtech Venture

Department: 19days

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Tulsa, OK

Description
We’re 19days, a problem-obsessed venture studio. Our latest venture (still in stealth) is taking aim at some of the biggest bugs in insurance.

Much of how the industry currently operates is labor intensive, slow, frustrating for customers, and in various instances leaves both customers and service providers with out-of-pocket expenses for a time.

We have validated a big opportunity is to build an AI workforce in insurance, and it is a far larger than most SaaS businesses because we are not going after the software budgets that make up 5% of costs, but rather the labor budgets that make up 30% of costs.

We have done our deep dive on one line of business in particular where the status quo is impacting adoption and is resulting in excessive policy churn. Our discovery included numerous interviews, ethnographies, surveys with consumers, providers, subject matter experts in insurance and chief executives from leading insurance carriers.

We’re in the midst of finalizing development partnerships with well-known insurance carriers to build a beginning-to-end agent with real-world insurance data and information.

Our 19days venture studio is backed by its full-stack innovation partner Gitwit and collectively we already have measurable success in building and marketing practical, but game-changing, AI solutions in the health care and death care spaces. Behind this proven track record is a super resourceful team in all areas of launching and growing a business that will be at your disposal. The power of a venture studio is it enables the CEO to focus on the most important few things and use his or her specific strengths to drive progress and success.

We are looking for a CEO to come lead the launch efforts, assemble your dedicated founding team, focus and guide product development, and establish more partnerships with carriers. Goals in the first year are to prove the product, recruit and delight initial customers, and complete the foundation work to build a massively scalable venture.

Your mission as Chief Executive Officer… Build a rocket ship of a startup.
• Assemble your founding team (engineer and product SME)
• Drive the vision for how this company is going to revolutionize an industry
• Deeply understand the carriers operational process and guide the team to deliver a product that changes the way a customer does business by 4 delta
• “Stay in the weeds” in order to set clear priorities for your team and drive excellence in details and execution for a rapidly evolving technology doing a complex array of tasks
• Keep the team focused so we outperform other companies trying to innovate in this space
• Conquer one industry with an incredible AI agent and set the stage to move to another vertical
• Be the chief evangelist and story teller to investors, customers, and your team

Qualifications
• An experienced builder: teams, products, and tech (experience in insurance is a plus)
• Possess product sensibility: know what customers want and are willing to pay for
• People-centered leadership: building a team through coaching, goal setting, and communication
• Past startup, innovation, or growth experience

Our ideal CEO is someone who:
• Excels at vision setting
• Exudes an “own it all” instead of a “know it all” mindset
• Moves fast and boldly with a sense of urgency
• Experiments, learns quickly, and adapts
• Gives and receives frequent feedback
• Is results-driven and ambitious
• Asks good questions that expose “the why”

Benefits
• Competitive startup salary with options
• Excellent health and dental insurance with 99% of the employee premium paid by us
• 100% of life insurance
• Private and collaborative workspace at one of the coolest office buildings in Tulsa

We find real problems, validate products, then rapidly build companies to give them a much greater chance for success. The 19days studio was built around the core belief that industry-changing solutions are born out of clear, focused, real world problems, and that the best venture studios are those that find the best problems, most efficiently. That’s exactly what we designed 19days to do.

19days is built upon Gitwit - a full-service marketing and product company with the complete team to innovate from 0 to 1. As CEO, you’ll have access to a 40+ person team composed of researchers, strategists, technologists, writers, designers, animators, data scientists, and engineers to rapidly build a successful venture.

Job Overview

As a Security Engineer at Contextual AI, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security and integrity of our AI systems and platforms. You will work closely with our engineering and product teams to design, implement, and maintain robust security measures that safeguard our systems, data, and infrastructure against potential threats and vulnerabilities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of cybersecurity in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence.

What you’ll do:

• Design and implement security architecture for our AI systems, including network security, encryption, access controls, and identity management.
• Develop and deploy tools and techniques for detecting and mitigating security threats, such as intrusion detection systems, malware protection, and vulnerability scanning.
• Lead incident response efforts in the event of security breaches or incidents, including investigation, containment, and remediation.
• Ensure compliance with relevant security standards, regulations, and best practices, such as GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
• Act as a key point of contact for customers’s vendor security processes, answering security questionnaires and ensuring compliance with security requirements.
• Educate and train engineering and product teams on security best practices, policies, and procedures.
• Conduct regular security testing, including penetration testing, code reviews, and security assessments, to identify and address potential vulnerabilities.
• Establish and maintain security operations processes and procedures, including monitoring, logging, and alerting.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security into the software development lifecycle and DevOps processes.

What we’re seeking:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
• 2+ years experience as a security engineer or similar role, preferably in a fast-paced startup environment.
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, practices, and technologies.
• Experience with cloud security, particularly GCP.
• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C/C++.
• Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST, CIS, and OWASP.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

job_description:
- The idea is to automate the risk assessment for third parties using AI and automation.

When a company or product is added to the system, the AI fills in all the answers to the questions asked in the system in relation to the third-party supplier. The questions could relate to the security of the third-party product manufactured, e.g. whether the data is encrypted at rest or whether it has an ISO certificate, etc.

What needs to be done:

AI can play a crucial role in conducting risk assessments of third parties by leveraging various technologies and methodologies:

- Data Analysis and Aggregation: gather and analyze vast amounts of data related to third-party activities, including financial records, operational metrics, cybersecurity practices, and compliance history. By aggregating and processing this data, AI can identify patterns, trends, and anomalies that may indicate potential risks associated with specific third parties.

- Predictive Analytics: AI-powered predictive analytics to assess the likelihood of various risks associated with third parties based on historical data, industry trends, and external factors. By analyzing past incidents and their contributing factors, AI can forecast potential risks and their potential impact on your organization.

- Natural Language Processing (NLP): NLP algorithms to analyze contracts, agreements, and other legal documents associated with third-party relationships to identify clauses, terms, and obligations that may pose legal or compliance risks. AI can also assess the sentiment and tone of communications with third parties to detect any signs of dissatisfaction or potential disputes.

- Supplier and Vendor Risk Management: AI to assist in evaluating the risk profiles of suppliers and vendors by analyzing factors such as their financial stability, operational resilience, geographical location, and regulatory compliance. By integrating external data sources and performing continuous monitoring, AI can provide insights into the overall risk exposure posed by third-party relationships.

- Cybersecurity Risk Assessment: AI-powered cybersecurity tools to assess the security posture of third parties by scanning their networks, systems, and applications for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and potential threats. By simulating cyber attacks and penetration testing, AI can identify weaknesses in third-party defenses and recommend remediation measures to mitigate risks.

- Regulatory Compliance Monitoring: AI to monitor regulatory changes and updates relevant to third-party relationships and assess their potential impact on your organization's compliance obligations. By analyzing regulatory requirements and industry standards, AI can help ensure that third parties adhere to relevant laws, regulations, and contractual obligations.

- Decision Support Systems: AI-powered decision support systems to assist risk managers and stakeholders in evaluating the overall risk exposure associated with third-party relationships and making informed decisions. By providing risk scores, prioritizing mitigation actions, and recommending risk management strategies, AI can enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of risk assessment processes.

- Automated Vulnerability Scanning: AI-powered tools to automatically scan third-party software for known vulnerabilities, including those listed in databases like CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures). These tools can efficiently identify potential security weaknesses within the software.

- Behavioral Analysis: AI algorithms to analyze the behavior of third-party software to detect any suspicious or malicious activities. By monitoring network traffic, system interactions, and file behavior, AI can identify anomalies that may indicate security risks.

- Code Analysis: AI-based static and dynamic code analysis tools to scrutinize the source code of third-party software for security flaws, coding errors, and compliance with best practices. These tools can identify vulnerabilities such as injection flaws, insecure authentication mechanisms, and improper error handling.

- Historical Data Analysis: AI to analyze historical data on security incidents related to similar third-party software. By leveraging large datasets and machine learning algorithms, AI can predict potential risks associated with using specific software based on past experiences.

- Integration with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Systems: AI-powered risk assessment tools to integrate with GRC systems to streamline the assessment process. These tools can provide real-time risk scores, prioritize vulnerabilities, and generate comprehensive reports for decision-making.

- Continuous Monitoring and Adaptive Risk Assessment: AI can enable continuous monitoring of third-party software for emerging threats and vulnerabilities. By adapting to changing environments and threat landscapes, AI can provide ongoing risk assessment and mitigation recommendations.
